args.query: EIA-861 utility residential revenue sales customers ownership type

sql: WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM energy.eia_utility_annual WHERE state_abbr='WI' AND report_year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2023 AND customers_residential>0 AND sales_residential_mwh>0 AND service_type='Bundled'), full_ AS (SELECT utility_id FROM w WHERE report_year IN (2020,2023) GROUP BY utility_id HAVING count(*)=2) SELECT report_year, entity_type, count(*) n, sum(customers_residential) cust, sum(revenue_residential_thousand)/sum(sales_residential_mwh) AS cents_per_kwh_x10 FROM w WHERE utility_id IN (SELECT utility_id FROM full_) AND report_year IN (2020,2021,2022,2023) GROUP BY report_year, entity_type ORDER BY entity_type, report_year

SELECT utility_name, entity_type, report_year, customers_residential, round(revenue_residential_thousand/sales_residential_mwh,4) AS usd_kwh, round(sales_residential_mwh*1000/customers_residential) kwh_per_cust FROM energy.eia_utility_annual WHERE state_abbr='WI' AND report_year IN (2020,2023) AND service_type='Bundled' AND (customers_residential>100000 OR utility_name ILIKE '%Cedarburg%' OR utility_name ILIKE '%Grafton%') ORDER BY utility_name, report_year
